steps.title: One router per verb
steps.body: Each of the ten skills is a SKILL.md router. It reads the ask, matches one routing row, and that row names the exact files to open. Nothing else is loaded.

steps.title: Branches do the work
steps.body: A matched row opens one branch under skills/<verb>/branches. Review groups its branches by what is judged: code, design, document, plus concerns that stack on any of them.

steps.title: Shared knowledge
steps.body: Standards live once under shared/<domain>, as leaves with no index file. A router or branch names the leaves it reads, so the same standard serves the verb that writes and the verb that judges.

steps.title: A worked path
steps.body: Review on a diff spawns reviewer prompts from shared/code-reviewers, one per failure class. Pick a skill in the filter bar to see only its flow and everything it reads.
